# external

Skills cloned or adapted from other authors, kept for trial and
customisation. They are not part of the published set: `skills/` holds
what this repo ships, and `check.py` ignores this directory. Each
subdirectory carries its own `NOTICE.md` with the source and licence.

Link one for local use with
`ln -sfn "$PWD/external/<source>/<skill>" ~/.agents/skills/<skill>`.
Promote a skill into `skills/` only after it earns a place and carries
your edits.
